images.title: Three ways things multiply
images.purpose: A clean summary of three results: each term times each term, the square of a sum, and a sum times a difference.
images.composition: Three equal cards in a row, each with a small picture above its identity. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: Card 1: a small rectangle split into 4 parts, teal (#0072B2); label '(a + b)(c + d) = ac + ad + bc + bd'. Card 2: a small square split into 4 parts (two squares teal, two rectangles amber #E69F00); label '(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²'. Card 3: a small square with a corner square removed, reddish purple (#CC79A7); label '(a + b)(a − b) = a² − b²'. Exactly 3 cards.
labels: (a + b)(c + d) = ac + ad + bc + bd
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Every product of sums comes from distributing each term.
images.description: A clean summary of three results: each term times each term, the square of a sum, and a sum times a difference.
images.teaching_notes: (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b² is left off to keep three items; it is (a + b)² with −b in place of b.

image_decisions.why: A recap image of the three core results gives students one picture to remember the chapter by.
